name: Position-changing mechanism
summary: Moves an apparatus between defined physical positions.
description: Moves an apparatus between defined physical positions.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the mechanism drive and selected target positions. The associated drawing should trace the actuator command, travel limits and status circuits; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
